title: How a Water Tower Supplies a Neighbourhood

beats.problem: A city needs clean water at every tap, every hour.
beats.narration: A city needs clean water at every tap, every hour.

beats.problem: One small pump can serve a home, but demand keeps growing.
beats.narration: One small pump can serve a home, but demand keeps growing.

beats.problem: Water pressure begins to fall across the nearby streets.
beats.narration: Water pressure begins to fall across the nearby streets.

beats.problem: A larger pump moves more water, but demand still fluctuates.
beats.narration: A larger pump moves more water, but demand still fluctuates.

beats.problem: During quiet hours, that extra capacity often sits unused.
beats.narration: During quiet hours, that extra capacity often sits unused.

beats.problem: So engineers build a storage tank above the surrounding homes.
beats.narration: So engineers build a storage tank above the surrounding homes.

beats.problem: Strong columns carry the enormous weight of the elevated tank.
beats.narration: Strong columns carry the enormous weight of the elevated tank.

beats.problem: Braces help resist side forces, including the push of wind.
beats.narration: Braces help resist side forces, including the push of wind.

beats.problem: Pumps fill the tank when supply and demand allow it.
beats.narration: Pumps fill the tank when supply and demand allow it.

beats.problem: The tank stores water high above the streets below.
beats.narration: The tank stores water high above the streets below.

beats.problem: Water can then descend through a large distribution main.
beats.narration: Water can then descend through a large distribution main.

beats.problem: The main runs underground along the roads of the neighbourhood.
beats.narration: The main runs underground along the roads of the neighbourhood.

beats.problem: Smaller service pipes branch off toward each house.
beats.narration: Smaller service pipes branch off toward each house.

beats.problem: The elevated supply helps smooth rapid changes in water demand.
beats.narration: The elevated supply helps smooth rapid changes in water demand.

beats.problem: Control valves can isolate a section for maintenance.
beats.narration: Control valves can isolate a section for maintenance.

beats.problem: Sensors tell operators when the tank needs refilling.
beats.narration: Sensors tell operators when the tank needs refilling.

beats.problem: This storage also adds resilience during short interruptions.
beats.narration: This storage also adds resilience during short interruptions.

beats.problem: And that is how one water tower helps supply a neighbourhood.
